name: lookup_member_balance_discovered
description: Log in, look up member {member_id}, and read their current savings balance — discovered via a genuine LLM-driven discovery run. Outcome summary: Logged in successfully, searched for member 10001 (Testy McTestface), and found their current savings balance is 4,200.00.

inputParams.name: username
inputParams.description: CU Console login username, resolved from the DEMO_USER env var.

inputParams.name: password
inputParams.description: CU Console login password, resolved from the DEMO_PASS env var.

inputParams.name: member_id
inputParams.description: Bound parameter "member_id" for this discovery run.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Value read from e0 at goal completion (candidate output "savings_balance").

source.rationale: role+name unique on page (role="link" name="Open sub-account"); css added as a generated shortest-unique structural path; xpath absolute path added as structural fallback; text_anchor dropped (no nearby label/header/cell text found); visual_anchor added as the last-resort bounding-box fallback

target.rationale: role+name unique on page (role="textbox" name="Username"); css added via [name="username"] (name may be tenant-branded elsewhere); xpath absolute path added as structural fallback; text_anchor from nearby label/cell text "Username"; visual_anchor added as the last-resort bounding-box fallback

role+name unique on page (role="textbox" name="Password"); css added via [name="password"] (name may be tenant-branded elsewhere); xpath absolute path added as structural fallback; text_anchor from nearby label/cell text "Password"; visual_anchor added as the last-resort bounding-box fallback

role+name unique on page (role="button" name="Log in"); css added as a generated shortest-unique structural path; xpath absolute path added as structural fallback; text_anchor from nearby label/cell text "Username"; visual_anchor added as the last-resort bounding-box fallback

steps.description: Enter text into "Member ID or name".
